definition: the speaker believes the hearer's work will go forward again
expansion: (situation BELIEF (HOLDER (term SELF)) (CONTENT (situation progress (UNDERGOER (situation work (ACTOR (term INTERLOCUTOR)))) (EVENT-TIME AFTER NOW))))
